name: photo-mechanic
title: Photo Mechanic
description: Send your active Lightroom Classic photo to Photo Mechanic with a single keystroke.
author: dustchambers

commands.name: send-to-photo-mechanic
commands.title: Open Lightroom Photo in Photo Mechanic
commands.description: Reveals the active Lightroom Classic photo in Photo Mechanic — equivalent to dragging the file onto Photo Mechanic's icon.

preferences.name: delay
preferences.title: Show in Finder Delay
preferences.description: Seconds to wait after triggering Show in Finder before reading the file path. Increase if your catalog is on a slow network drive.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use the \`npm run publish\` command.

" && exit 1
